# teams_meeting_broadcast_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing MeetingBroadcastConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_sdn_provider_for_broadcast_meeting` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowSdnProviderForBroadcastMeeting parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `sdn_api_template_url` (String) Maps to the -SdnApiTemplateUrl parameter.
- `sdn_api_token` (String) Maps to the -SdnApiToken parameter.
- `sdn_license_id` (String) Maps to the -SdnLicenseId parameter.
- `sdn_provider_name` (String) Maps to the -SdnProviderName parameter.
- `sdn_runtime_configuration` (String) Maps to the -SdnRuntimeConfiguration parameter.
- `support_url` (String) Maps to the -SupportURL parameter.
